f.title: Treat serious ADR reporting by manufacturers, sponsors and MAHs as mandatory
f.statement: Mandatory reporting means reporting of serious adverse reactions observed during a clinical trial or after authorisation. For this rulebook it is carried out by the manufacturer, the clinical trial sponsor, the investigator or the responsible organisation conducting the trial (the 'applicant'), and the marketing authorisation holder.

rows.actor: Manufacturer, clinical trial sponsor/applicant and marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: "Задолжително пријавување" e пријавување на сериозните несакани реакции на лекот, забележани во текот на клиничкото испитување или во периодот по добивањето на одобрението. Задолжителното пријавување, во смисла на овој правилник, го врши производителот на лекот, спонзорот на клиничкото испитување, истражувачот, односно одговорната организација во која се спроведува клиничкото испитување (во натамошниот текст: подносител на барањето), како и носителот на одобрението;
rows.review_note: Review: definition kept because it sets who must report serious ADRs. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: "Mandatory reporting" is the reporting of serious adverse reactions to the medicine observed during a clinical trial or in the period after obtaining the authorisation. Mandatory reporting, within the meaning of this rulebook, is carried out by the manufacturer of the medicine, the sponsor of the clinical trial, the investigator or the responsible organisation in which the clinical trial is conducted (hereinafter: the applicant), as well as the marketing authorisation holder;

f.title: Report SUSARs, increased-frequency expected SARs, serious hazards and active-comparator SUSARs from trials
f.statement: The applicant of an authorised clinical trial or post-marketing interventional trial reports to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre: (1) serious unexpected adverse reactions during the trial; (2) serious expected adverse reactions with a clinically significant increased incidence; (3) serious hazards to the patient during the trial (e.g. lack of efficacy in life-threatening disease); (4) serious unexpected adverse reactions to a medicine used as active control, of which the MAH in North Macedonia is also informed.
f.clause: II. Фармаковигиланца во клиничко испитување на лек, Член 4

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: Од страна на подносителот на барањето за клиничко испитување на лек (во натамошниот текст: подносител на барањето) за кој е добиена дозвола за спроведување на клиничкото испитување или за постмаркетишкото интервенциско клиничко испитување се пријавуваат до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца:
rows.location: II. Фармаковигиланца во клиничко испитување на лек, Член 4
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; the four categories follow. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The applicant for a clinical trial of a medicine (hereinafter: the applicant) for which authorisation has been obtained to conduct the clinical trial or the post-marketing interventional clinical trial reports the following to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre:

f.title: In multicentre trials, report qualifying reactions from all participating countries
f.statement: If a multicentre clinical trial is also conducted in North Macedonia, the applicant reports the adverse reactions in Article 4(1) that occurred in any of the countries where the trial is conducted.

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: Ако мултицентрично клиничко испитување се спроведува и во Република Македонија, од страна на подносителот на барањето се пријавуваат несаканите реакции на лекот од став 1 од овој член кои се појавиле во било која од земјите во кои се спроведува клиничкото испитување.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If a multicentre clinical trial is also conducted in the Republic of Macedonia, the applicant reports the adverse reactions referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article which occurred in any of the countries in which the clinical trial is conducted.

f.title: Report fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 24 hours to the Agency, PV Centre and Ethics Committee
f.statement: Serious unexpected adverse reactions during a clinical trial that are fatal or life-threatening are reported by the applicant immediately to the Agency, the National Pharmacovigilance Centre and the Ethics Committee, at the latest 24 hours from first knowledge (initial report).

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.deadline: Immediately, at the latest 24 hours from first knowledge
rows.quote: Сериозните, неочекувани несакани реакции што се случиле за време на клиничкото испитување на лекот и имаат смртен исход или претставуваат закана по животот, од страна на подносителот на барањето веднаш се пријавуваат до Агенцијата, Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца и Етичката комисија, а најдоцна 24 часа од првичното сознание (во натамошниот текст: иницијална пријава).
rows.review_note: Review: 24-hour initial report is stricter than the EU 7-day rule. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Serious, unexpected adverse reactions which occurred during the clinical trial of the medicine and have a fatal outcome or are life-threatening are reported by the applicant immediately to the Agency, the National Pharmacovigilance Centre and the Ethics Committee, and at the latest 24 hours from the first knowledge (hereinafter: initial report).

f.title: Send the complete report on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs within 7 days of the initial report
f.statement: The applicant then submits a subsequent complete report to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre at the latest within seven days from the day the initial report was submitted.

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.deadline: At the latest 7 days from submission of the initial report
rows.quote: Пријавувањето од страна на подносителот на барањето се врши со доставување на следна пријава (во натамошниот текст: целосна пријава), најдоцна во рок од седум дена од денот на доставување на пријавата од став 1 од овој член, до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Reporting by the applicant is carried out by submitting a subsequent report (hereinafter: complete report), at the latest within seven days from the day of submission of the report referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre.

deadline_rule.clock_start: од денот на доставување на пријавата од став 1 од овој член
deadline_rule.applies_to: complete report on fatal or life-threatening SUSARs

f.title: Report other SUSARs within 15 days of first notification
f.statement: Serious unexpected adverse reactions that are not fatal or life-threatening are reported by the applicant to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre at the latest within 15 days from the day of first notification of the reaction.

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.deadline: At the latest 15 days from first notification
rows.quote: Сериозните, неочекувани несакани реакции што немаат смртен исход или не претставуваат закана по животот, од страна на подносителот на барањето се пријавуваат најдоцна во рок од 15 дена од денот на првото известување за ваквата несакана реакција, до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Serious, unexpected adverse reactions which do not have a fatal outcome or are not life-threatening are reported by the applicant at the latest within 15 days from the day of the first notification of such adverse reaction, to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre.

deadline_rule.clock_start: од денот на првото известување за ваквата несакана реакција

f.title: Submit an annual periodic report of all trial adverse reactions and a final safety report
f.statement: The applicant submits to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre once a year a periodic report on all adverse reactions observed during the clinical trial and, after the end of the trial, a final report on the safety of the investigational medicine.

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.deadline: Annually; final report after the end of the trial
rows.quote: Подносителот на барањето до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца еднаш годишно доставува периодичен извештај за сите несакани реакции забележани во текот на клиничкото испитување на лекот, а по завршувањето на клиничкото испитување завршен извештај за безбедноста на испитуваниот лек.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The applicant submits to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre once a year a periodic report on all adverse reactions observed during the clinical trial of the medicine, and after the completion of the clinical trial a final report on the safety of the investigational medicine.

f.title: Include minimum data in the initial SUSAR report
f.statement: The initial report contains at least: the patient (subject) identification code and initials; the INN of the medicine; the adverse reaction; the clinical trial identifier; and the name and address of the applicant.

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: Иницијалната пријава од член 5 став 1 од овој правилник ги содржи најмалку следниве податоци:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; five items follow. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The initial report referred to in Article 5 paragraph 1 of this rulebook contains at least the following data:

f.title: Include trial, subject, suspect drug, reaction, concomitant drug, investigator and applicant data in the complete report
f.statement: The complete report contains data on: the trial (protocol number, phase and purpose, investigational medicine, indication, authorisation number); the subject (initials, code, age, sex, weight, height, country); the suspect medicine (INN or trade name, batch, indication, form and strength, dosing, route, start and end dates and times); the adverse reaction(s); concomitant medicines including OTC, traditional and homeopathic medicines and dietary products; the investigators (name, telephone, occupation and specialty, signature and date); and the applicant (name and address, date of first notification of the SUSAR to the sponsor).

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: Целосната пријава од член 5 став 2 од овој правилник ги содржи податоците за:
data_elements: date of first notification to sponsor
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; list summarised. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The complete report referred to in Article 5 paragraph 2 of this rulebook contains the data on:

f.title: Describe each adverse reaction in detail (ICD-10, dates, treatment, dechallenge/rechallenge, outcome)
f.statement: For each adverse reaction the report gives: a detailed description of all reactions (signs and symptoms) with site, seriousness and seriousness criteria and, where possible, a specific ICD-10 diagnosis; start and end date and time; symptomatic treatment and other measures; dechallenge and rechallenge information; outcome (death with cause, causality comment and post-mortem findings where available, permanent damage, hospitalisation, life threat, recovery); and other relevant information (history, laboratory and diagnostic results, allergy, pregnancy, drug or alcohol abuse, family history).

rows.actor: Applicant for a clinical trial (sponsor, investigator or responsible organisation; 'подносител на барањето')
rows.quote: За несаканата/ите реакција/и од член 7 точка 4) од овој правилник се наведуваат следните податоци:
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the chapeau; list summarised. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: For the adverse reaction(s) referred to in Article 7 point 4) of this rulebook the following data are stated:

f.title: Make public statements on product pharmacovigilance only with prior Agency approval, objectively
f.statement: The marketing authorisation holder may give the public information on the pharmacovigilance of its medicine only after prior approval from the Agency; such information must be objective, i.e. not biased.
f.clause: III. Фармаковигиланца на лековите во промет, Член 10

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Во јавноста информација која се однесува на фармаковигиланцата на својот лек може да биде дадена од страна на носителот на одобрението по претходно добиено одобрение од Агенцијата. Инфорамциите за фармаковигиланцата од став 1 од овој член, треба да бидат обејктивни, односно да немаат пристрасен карактер (необјективен).
rows.location: III. Фармаковигиланца на лековите во промет, Член 10
rows.review_note: Review: 'може ... по претходно добиено одобрение' sets a pre-approval condition, read as mandatory; objectivity ('треба') kept in the same row. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Information relating to the pharmacovigilance of its medicine may be given to the public by the marketing authorisation holder after prior approval obtained from the Agency. The information on pharmacovigilance referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article should be objective, i.e. should not have a biased (non-objective) character.

f.title: Designate a person responsible for pharmacovigilance
f.statement: Under the law, the marketing authorisation holder designates a person responsible for pharmacovigilance to implement the pharmacovigilance system, who carries out the tasks listed in Article 17.
f.clause: IV. Начин на организација на системот на фармаковигиланца, Член 17

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: Од страна на носителот на одобрението за ставање на лек во промет, согласно закон за спроведување на системот на фармаковигиланца се определува лице одговорно за фармаковигиланца кое:
rows.location: IV. Начин на организација на системот на фармаковигиланца, Член 17
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The marketing authorisation holder, in accordance with the law, designates for the implementation of the pharmacovigilance system a person responsible for pharmacovigilance who:

f.title: Organise and maintain a system collecting, processing, assessing and storing all ADR data regardless of origin
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance organises and maintains the system for collection, processing, assessment and storage of data on all adverse events or reactions reported to the manufacturer or the marketing authorisation holder, regardless of the geographical origin of the data.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: го организира и одржува системот на собирање, обработка, проценка и чување на податоците за сите несакани настани или реакции на лек пријавени до производителот на лекот, до носителот на одобрението без оглед на географското потекло на изворот на податоците;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: organises and maintains the system of collection, processing, assessment and storage of data on all adverse events or reactions to the medicine reported to the manufacturer of the medicine or to the marketing authorisation holder, regardless of the geographical origin of the data source;

f.title: Propose safety measures and provide full, timely responses to the PV Centre
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance proposes to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre measures to be implemented for safety reasons, and provides complete and timely responses and the information needed to assess the safety of the medicine and the health risk of its use.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: предлага до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца мерки што треба да се спроведат од безбедносни причини, обезбедува целосни и навремени одговори и потребни информации, заради проценка на безбедноста на лекот и ризикот по здравјето при неговата употреба;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: proposes to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre measures to be implemented for safety reasons, provides complete and timely answers and the necessary information for the assessment of the safety of the medicine and the health risk of its use;

f.title: Notify the PV Centre of all serious ADRs occurring in North Macedonia
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance notifies the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of all serious adverse reactions, or suspected adverse reactions, that occurred in the territory of the Republic (North) Macedonia. The rulebook sets no time limit for this.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: го известува Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца за сите сериозни несакани реакции на лекот, односно сомневање за несакани реакции што се случиле на територија на Република Македонија;
rows.review_note: Review: no deadline in the rulebook (the law may set one); flagged. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: notifies the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of all serious adverse reactions to the medicine, or suspected adverse reactions, which occurred in the territory of the Republic of Macedonia;

f.title: Notify the PV Centre of all serious ADRs reported outside North Macedonia
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance notifies the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of all serious adverse reactions, or suspected adverse reactions, reported outside the territory of the Republic (North) Macedonia. No time limit is set in the rulebook.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: го известува Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца за сите сериозни несакани реакции на лек, односно сомневање за несакани реакции, што се пријавени надвор од територијата на Република Македонија;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: notifies the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of all serious adverse reactions to the medicine, or suspected adverse reactions, which are reported outside the territory of the Republic of Macedonia;

f.title: Report serious ADRs from post-marketing non-interventional studies
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance reports, as for domestic and foreign cases (points 3 and 4), all serious adverse reactions occurring during post-marketing non-interventional (pharmacoepidemiological) studies.
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Epidemiology / safety studies

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: ги пријавува согласно точките 3) и 4) од овој член сите сериозни несакани реакции на лекот за време на постмаркетиншкото неинтервенциско клиничко испитување (фармакоепидемиолошко испитување);
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: reports, in accordance with points 3) and 4) of this Article, all serious adverse reactions to the medicine during the post-marketing non-interventional clinical study (pharmacoepidemiological study);

f.title: Notify the PV Centre of abuse and uncontrolled use affecting the benefit-risk balance
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance notifies the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of all cases of abuse and uncontrolled use of the medicine that affect the risk-benefit assessment.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: го известува Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца за сите злоупотреби и неконтролирано земање на лек што имаат влијание на проценката на односот ризик/корист;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: notifies the National Pharmacovigilance Centre of all abuse and uncontrolled intake of the medicine which have an impact on the assessment of the risk/benefit balance;

f.title: Submit PSURs listing all other suspected adverse reactions
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance submits the periodic safety update report (PSUR) to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre, listing all other adverse reactions suspected to be related to use of the medicine.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: го доставува периодичниот извештај за безбедноста на лекот до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца во кој се наведени сите останати несакани реакции за кои постои сомневање дека се поврзани со употребата на лекот;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: submits the periodic safety update report to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre, in which all other adverse reactions suspected to be related to the use of the medicine are listed;

f.title: Prepare reports to the PV Centre on all QPPV tasks
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance prepares a report to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on the tasks in points 1 to 7 of Article 17, in accordance with the law and this rulebook.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: подготвува извештај до Националниот центар за фармаковигиланца за работите од точка 1 до точка 7 од овој член согласно со закон и со овој правилник;
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: prepares a report to the National Pharmacovigilance Centre on the tasks from point 1 to point 7 of this Article in accordance with the law and this rulebook;

f.title: Provide additional safety information with sales and prescription quantities on request
f.statement: At the Agency's request the person responsible for pharmacovigilance provides, completely and in a timely manner, additional information needed to assess the safety of the medicine and the health risk, together with information on the quantities of the medicine sold and prescribed.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: обезбедува дополнителни информации на барање на Агенцијата што се неопходни за проценка на безбедноста на лекот и ризикот по здравјето што треба да бидат дадени во целост и навремено, заедно со информациите за количината на продадените и пропишаните лекови на кои се однесува информацијата.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: provides additional information at the request of the Agency which is necessary for the assessment of the safety of the medicine and the health risk, which should be given in full and in a timely manner, together with the information on the quantity of the medicines sold and prescribed to which the information relates.

f.title: At the first MA renewal, submit the individual 6-monthly, annual and 3-yearly PSURs
f.statement: At the first renewal of the marketing authorisation, the person responsible for pharmacovigilance submits to the Agency the individual PSURs (six-monthly, annual and three-yearly).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Од страна на лицето одговорно за фармаковигиланца при првото обновување на одобрението за ставање на лек во промет, до Агенцијата се доставуваат поединечните PSUR-ови (шестмесечни, едногодишни и тригодишни).
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: At the first renewal of the marketing authorisation, the person responsible for pharmacovigilance submits to the Agency the individual PSURs (six-monthly, annual and three-yearly).

f.title: At later renewals, submit five-year cumulative PSURs (summary bridging report) within 60 days of period end
f.statement: At each subsequent renewal, the individual PSURs should cover a five-year period with cumulative data from the date of authorisation or of the last renewal (Summary Bridging Report), at the latest 60 days from the end of the period covered.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.deadline: At the latest 60 days from the end of the period covered
rows.quote: При секое наредно обновување на одобрението за ставање на лекот во промет поединечните PSUR-ови треба да опфаќаат период од пет години, со кумулативни податоци што се однесуваат на периодот од денот на добивањето на одобрението или на периодот од денот на последното обновување на одобрението за ставање на лекот во промет (Summary Bridging Report), најдоцна 60 дена од денот на истекот на периодот за кој се однесува.
rows.review_note: Review: 'треба' (should) with a firm 'најдоцна' (at the latest) deadline; kept Mandatory, confidence held below 90 for the modal. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: At each subsequent renewal of the marketing authorisation, the individual PSURs should cover a period of five years, with cumulative data relating to the period from the day the authorisation was obtained or from the day of the last renewal of the marketing authorisation (Summary Bridging Report), at the latest 60 days from the day of expiry of the period to which it relates.

deadline_rule.clock_start: од денот на истекот на периодот за кој се однесува
deadline_rule.applies_to: five-year cumulative PSUR / summary bridging report at subsequent renewals

f.title: Structure the PSUR with title page, summary, index, sections 1-10 and annexes
f.statement: The PSUR contains a title page (trade name; manufacturer and MAH name and address and the unit and person responsible for the report; period covered; international birth date (country and date); date of preparation), a brief overview (worldwide registration status, patient exposure, number of ADR reports, key findings, conclusions), an index, sections 1 to 10 (introduction; worldwide authorisation status; safety actions taken; changes to the reference safety information; patient exposure; individual case histories; studies; other information; overall safety evaluation; conclusion) and annexes.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: PSUR-от содржи насловна страна, краток преглед, содржина (индекс), делови од 1 до 10 и прилози.
rows.review_note: Review: quote is the structural rule; content summarised from Art 19. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The PSUR contains a title page, a brief overview, contents (index), parts 1 to 10 and annexes.

f.title: Code PSUR case terms in MedDRA or WHO-ART and provide line listings and summary tabulations
f.statement: In the individual case histories section of the PSUR, adverse reaction terms must follow WHO-ART or MedDRA, always stating the term used in the initial report (an ICD-10 diagnosis may be proposed for symptom complexes). The section includes a line listing of all serious ADRs (spontaneous, from post-marketing studies, from the authority or literature) and non-serious unexpected spontaneous or literature cases, with listed data items; a summary tabulation by organ system and source (serious ADRs in a separate table); and an analysis of individual cases.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote:
преглед на поединечни случаи (во описот на случајот, терминот за несакани реакции треба да е во согласност со стандардната терминологија на Светската здравствена организација - WHO-ART, односно со медицинскиот речник за регулаторни активности -
MedDRA, со задолжително наведување на терминот што е употребен во иницијалната пријава,
rows.review_note: Review: 'задолжително' (mandatory) supports Mandatory for stating the reported term. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: overview of individual cases (in the case description, the adverse reaction term should be in accordance with the standard terminology of the World Health Organization - WHO-ART, or with the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities - MedDRA, with mandatory statement of the term used in the initial report,

f.title: Attach the latest core reference safety document (SmPC, patient leaflet) to the PSUR
f.statement: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance submits with the PSUR the latest version of the manufacturer's core reference safety document (summary of product characteristics, patient leaflet).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder, through its person responsible for pharmacovigilance
rows.quote: Кон PSUR-от од страна на одговорното лице за фармаковигиланца се доставува и последната верзија на основниот референтен документ за безбедноста на лекот од производителот на лекот (збирен извештај за особините на лекот, упатство за пациентот).
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: The person responsible for pharmacovigilance also submits with the PSUR the latest version of the core reference document on the safety of the medicine from the manufacturer of the medicine (summary of product characteristics, patient leaflet).

f.title: Propose urgent safety measures to the Agency immediately after a serious ADR with serious consequences
f.statement: On receipt of a report of a serious adverse reaction that may have serious consequences for human health, the marketing authorisation holder immediately submits to the Agency a proposal for urgent safety measures.
f.processes: Signal management; Risk management & minimisation; Submission operations

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote: По приемот на пријава за сериозна несакана реакција на лек што може да има сериозни последици по здравјето на луѓето, од страна на носителот на одобрението веднаш се доставува до Агенцијата предлог за итни мерки на безбедност.
rows.review_note: Review: Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: Upon receipt of a report of a serious adverse reaction to a medicine which may have serious consequences for human health, the marketing authorisation holder immediately submits to the Agency a proposal for urgent safety measures.

f.title: Implement urgent safety measures if the Agency does not respond within 24 hours
f.statement: If the Agency does not respond within 24 hours of receiving the MAH's proposal, the urgent safety measures are introduced in accordance with the marketing authorisation rules. Urgent safety measures are taken when the benefit-risk balance changes and significant changes to the product status are needed: withdrawal from the market; SmPC changes (new contraindications, warnings or precautions, dose reduction, restriction of indications); and informing health professionals and patients of the newly identified risk without delay.
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Safety labeling; Safety communications

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: If no Agency response within 24 hours
rows.quote: Ако Агенцијата не одговори во текот на 24 часа од денот на приемот од страна на носителот на одобрението се воведуваат итните мерки на безбедност согласно со прописите со кои е уредено добивањето на одобрението за ставање на лек во промет.
rows.review_note: Review: types of urgent measures (paragraph 3) added to the statement. Translation check: re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning, modal force and numbers.
rows.quote_en: If the Agency does not respond within 24 hours of the day of receipt, the marketing authorisation holder introduces the urgent safety measures in accordance with the regulations governing the obtaining of the marketing authorisation.

dates.title: North Macedonia PV rulebook (Sl. vesnik 93/2008): enters into force
dates.scope: Marketing authorisation holders, clinical trial applicants/sponsors, health institutions and professionals
dates.quote: Овој правилник влегува во сила осмиот ден од денот на објавувањето во "Службен весник на Република Македонија".
dates.quote_en: This rulebook enters into force on the eighth day from the day of publication in the Official Gazette of the Republic of Macedonia.
